package.name: mower_common
package.description: Shared Python library (no nodes) for the Airseekers Tron ROS 2 packages: the rclpy subscription pump (sub_pump), node clocks (clock), angle helpers (angles), the mission motion phases (phases) and the robot geometry constants (geometry). Created 2026-10-23 (code review stage 0.3) to replace 11 identical sub_pump.py copies and per-package duplicates.
